methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The aim of this paper is to present a model for the development and implementation of EnPIs for in-house energy management in a kraft pulp mill

paper_type.evidence_quote: The study was carried out as a multiple case study, as described by Yin (2014). Three kraft pulp mills constitute the studied cases.

level_3b.evidence_quote: Three kraft pulp mills constitute the studied cases.

stage1.notes: Practice-based multiple case study of three kraft pulp mills (one company group) presenting a tailored EnPI development model; validation is qualitative/experiential at the reference mill.

multi_site.evidence_quote: Three kraft pulp mills constitute the studied cases. All mills belonged to the same group of companies.

country_region.evidence_quote: Sweden is the context of the case study in this paper
